headline: LODE RUNNER-LITE: dig three floors down, and the grave pays
lede: The vault floor is now three diggable strata thick. Pit-bottom digs carve a shaft three cells to bedrock, guards that take the shortcut ride the lids down — and a buried guard finally scores 500, the number the 1983 machine paid.

notes.text: Three strata shipped (#1952, PR #1956): walk level up one row, ground three brick layers deep, shafts carve to row 18 and climb out three. Canvas and tile art untouched — the third stratum is more of the same warm mortar.

Buried guards pay 500 (CFG.guardPay) — the original's score: gold 500, buried guard 500, vault 1000. That pay is the reason-to-dig-deep the README said was missing; the toast reads A GUARD IS BURIED +500.

Harness grew honest: lodecheck 133/133 with three new mutants dead (guardPay=0, third-stratum-iron, strata=2); lodeplay 33/33 drives the three-cell shaft with real keys, state and pixels agreeing at every step. Solver untouched — every vault still winnable no-dig.

PLAICRAFT S1 (#1711) re-verified code-complete at main and released back to next: the four remaining acceptance lines need Jon's phone and the R2 bucket (relay worker + wrangler.toml ready; #1730 defaulted Hold — lanes don't self-serve).

look.text: Dig a three-cell shaft and bury a guard for 500 — LODE RUNNER-LITE
